timing_rule: close of first XNYS session strictly after SEC acceptance local date; explicit AI-assisted assumption, not approved execution eligibility
scope: exploratory retrospective training-only shrinkage calibration; extension designed after inspecting raw-blend losses
calibration: alpha=clip(sum_{i<j}(K_ij*R_B_ij)/sum_{i<j}(K_ij^2),0,1); alpha=0 for zero denominator; R_B is trailing Ledoit-Wolf correlation
calibrated_kernel: (1-alpha)I+alpha K; alpha fit separately per decision and representation using trailing returns only
portfolio: equal weights in fixed corpus/security order
losses: squared error of equal-weight daily portfolio variance against centered next-21-session sample covariance, ddof=1
secondary_losses: mean squared covariance-entry error over all n*n entries
mean squared covariance-entry error over off-diagonal entries
aggregate: equal mean of window losses; improvement=1-model_mean_loss/price_only_mean_loss; no tuning, selection or significance tests
controls: separately calibrated score-level kernel per representation
original fixed 25% raw-cosine blend per representation
constant_correlation: rho=mean off-diagonal trailing R_B, clipped to [-1/(n-1),1] for floating-point bounds; target=(1-rho)I+rho11T
constraints: fixed lambda=0.25; no future-label selection of alpha, model or blend weight; no model ranking or significance tests
chronology_limit: November embeddings and unknown training cutoffs; source identities and eligibility assumptions remain AI-assisted. Prior November snapshot included these price dates. The three risk-loss windows and raw/control results were already inspected before this extension.
